title: Returned Payment Reversals on Kestrel Auto Finance Contracts
content:
When the customer's bank returns a posted payment on a Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts contract, the whole payment is reversed.

## What the reversal does

| Part of the original payment | Effect of the return |
|---|---|
| Principal portion | reinstated to the principal balance |
| Each fee it paid | reinstated by assessing that fee again as a new entry of the same fee type |
| Last payment date | reverts to its value before the payment |
| Next due date | reverts to its value before the payment |
| Returned-payment fee | "and the tier's returned-payment fee is assessed" — **this clause is no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the returned-payment fee |

## Once only

A payment is reversed only once. The return entry names the payment it reverses; a payment that already has a return entry naming it is not reversed again.

## Autopay

Autopay stays enrolled after one returned payment.

## Hypothetical case

A 450.00 online payment had been split 80.00 interest, 15.00 to a late fee and 355.00 principal, and had moved the next due date from the 10th of one month to the 10th of the next. When the bank returns it, 355.00 is reinstated to principal, a new late-fee entry of 15.00 is assessed, and the last payment date and the next due date go back to what they were before the payment. Autopay, if enrolled, remains enrolled.

superseded_clauses: and the tier's returned-payment fee is assessed.
